race.description: Andrew Wilson Online Auctions Mdn Plate
race.comment: JACK WILL (11) is only lightly tried, and he got home strongly late fresh up at Warrnambool just over 2 weeks ago. He steps up from 1300m to a more suitable 1600m, and can figure in the top 3. ALMORINA (7) had plenty of jump-out experience prior to a modest effort on debut when well found in the market. he would have learned a lot, and her breeding suggests that she will be better once she gets out over more ground. She cops a wide gate, but we think she will be a sharp improver in this. Each way. CHAMPAGNE SABRE (2) resumed from a long spell and finished third at Warrnambool over 1300m. He strips fitter, and steps up to a mile, so keep him safe. YANKEE STREET RAIN (5) can be forgiven his last start at Hamilton, and with the aid of the pole position, he is worth including in all combos.
